name: @phoenix/engine
description: Phoenix engine — session and driver layer. Starts as a thin wrapper around Appium's core + uiautomator2/xcuitest drivers; the fork happens here once Stage 0's single-session milestone is proven.
comment_appium: Appium itself and its drivers are installed and managed via the `appium` CLI (npm i -g appium; appium driver install uiautomator2), not as project dependencies. Mixing them here causes ERESOLVE conflicts between this project's pinned appium version and the driver's peer requirement.
